clips.headline: U.S. disables blockade runner
clips.credit: Oct 10, 2026: CENTCOM says it disabled a cargo ship that ignored warnings and tried to run the U.S. blockade of Iran. Video: U.S. Central Command

clips.headline: U.S. destroys Iran-linked dhow
clips.credit: Oct 6, 2026: CENTCOM says U.S. forces destroyed an Iranian-affiliated dhow that was surveilling U.S. ships; crew removed first. Video: U.S. Central Command
